title: ENFORCEMENT RULE OF THE CAREER EDUCATION ACT
full_text:
ENFORCEMENT RULE OF THE CAREER EDUCATION ACT

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Career Education Act and the Enforcement Decree of that Act, and matters necessary for their implementation.

Article 2 (Teachers Dedicated to Career Education)
The term "subject prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Education" in Article 4 (1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Career Education Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Decree") means "Career and College Admission Counseling" for secondary schools, among the subjects indicated in attached Table 1 of the Enforcement Rule of the Decree on Examination for Teacher Qualifications.

Article 3 (Designation, Operation, etc. of the National Career Education Center)
(1) The criteria for designating a National Career Education Center under Article 15 (1) of the Career Education Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") shall be as follows:
  1. The center shall be an institution or corporation falling under any of the following:
    (a) A research institute under Article 8 (1) of the Act on the Establishment, Operation and Fostering of Government-Funded Research Institutes;
    (b) A public institution under Article 4 of the Act on the Management of Public Institutions;
    (c) A non-profit corporation established under Article 32 of the Civil Act for the purpose of conducting education-related projects, including career education;
  2. The center shall have personnel and facilities meeting the criteria prescribed in the attached Table.
(2) A person seeking designation as a National Career Education Center shall apply to the Minister of Education by submitting an application for designation in attached Form No. 1, accompanied by the following documents (including electronic documents; hereinafter the same shall apply):
  1. Articles of incorporation or internal regulations (limited to where the institution or organization seeking designation has such articles or regulations);
  2. A statement of the status of personnel and facilities;
  3. A business plan for carrying out career education support services;
  4. All other documents relating to the designation of a National Career Education Center.
(3) Where the Minister of Education designates a National Career Education Center under Article 15 (1) of the Act, the Minister shall issue a certificate of designation in attached Form No. 2 to the applicant and post the name of the designated institution and other relevant information on the website of the Ministry of Education.
(4) Matters necessary for the designation and operation of National Career Education Centers, other than those prescribed in paragraphs (1) through (3), shall be determined by the Minister of Education.

Article 4 (Certification of Career Experience Institutions Providing Educational Donations)
(1) The application under Article 9 (2) of the Decree shall be in attached Form No. 3.
(2) The term "documents prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Education" in Article 9 (2) of the Decree means the following:
  1. Documents concerning records of operation of career experience programs or the results of self-assessment relating to such programs, where such records or results are available;
  2. Documents concerning personnel and facilities for providing career experience opportunities;
  3. Documents concerning experience programs necessary for career experience;
  4. All other documents relating to the provision of career experience opportunities.
(3) The certificate under Article 9 (5) of the Decree shall be in attached Form No. 4.
(4) Where the Minister of Education issues a certificate under Article 9 (5) of the Decree, the Minister shall record the issuance in the register of certificate issuance in attached Form No. 5, and shall prepare and maintain a certificate register for each certified institution in attached Form No. 6.

Article 5 (Reissuance of Certificates)
Where an educational donation career experience institution seeks reissuance of a certificate issued under Article 9 (5) of the Decree on any of the following grounds, it shall submit to the Minister of Education an application in attached Form No. 7, accompanied by the original certificate (except where the certificate has been lost) and all documents evidencing the reason for requesting reissuance:
  1. The certificate has become worn or unusable, or has been lost;
  2. Information entered in the certificate has changed.

Article 6 (Re-examination of Regulations)
The Minister of Education shall review the appropriateness of the criteria for designating a Career Education Center under Article 3 (1) and the documents required under the subparagraphs of Article 3 (2), every three years from March 1, 2022 (meaning by the day immediately preceding the reference date in each third year), and shall take measures for improvement, etc., as necessary.

ADDENDA <No. 85, December 23, 2015>
This Rule shall enter into force on December 23, 2015.

ADDENDA (Ordinance of the Ministry of Education on Partial Amendment of Seven Statutes to Establish Periods for Re-examination of Regulations) <No. 265, April 27, 2022>
This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDA <No. 292, December 19, 2022>
